empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a markdown file or a zip archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

card.agentsHint: {count, plural, =0 {Not linked to any agent yet} one {Linked to # agent:} other {Linked to # agents:}}
card.statsHint: Last 30 days: share of linked agents' runs that used this skill, and accept rate of their triaged findings.

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It is removed from every agent that uses it.

form.title: Configuration
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Shown as the block heading in the prompt.
form.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface. Write it as a directive: "Use when … Flag …".
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Use when a PR changes logic. Flag each new branch no test reaches.
form.bodyHint: Text only — inserted into the agent's prompt under "Skills / rules". Saving a changed body creates a new version.
form.invalid: Fill in a valid name, a description and a body.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from outside the workspace. Its body is someone else's instructions inside your agents' prompt — read it before enabling it for an agent.

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every content change snapshots the skill, so a run trace can always be matched to the exact text it used.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a markdown file or a zip archive. Only the skill's text is read.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB.
import.trustTitle: You are adding someone else's instructions
import.trustBody: Once linked to an agent, this text goes into its prompt. Check the body below for instructions you would not give your reviewer yourself.
import.confirm: I have read the body and trust this skill
import.readError: Could not read this file. Pick it again.

stats.pullHint: {used} of {runs} runs of linked agents had this skill in the prompt
stats.acceptHint: Accepted ÷ (accepted + dismissed) for findings of runs that used this skill
stats.noAgents: No agent links this skill yet.
stats.noFindings: No findings from runs that used this skill yet.
stats.footnote: Last {days} days, completed runs only. A finding counts for every skill that was in its run's prompt — the model does not tag findings per skill.
